name: node-agent-search
description: A node exposing DeepSeek search and safe HTTP fetch through the Harness web runtime API

node.desc: DeepSeek web search and safe page retrieval, plus the page the API key is saved on

query.description: The query to pass to DeepSeek native web search

search.description: Return structured source results from DeepSeek native web search

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL to retrieve safely

fetch.description: Return bounded HTML or text content from a public URL

action.description: status (the default) says whether a key is set; save keeps `api_key`; clear forgets the saved one

api_key.description: The DeepSeek API key to keep; only `save` takes one, and it is never read back

key.description: Check whether a DeepSeek API key is set, save one, or clear the saved one; never returns the key

ui.description: The DeepSeek search page: save or clear the API key it searches with
